note: Tidecaller Mist Caller (unit identity, Tidecallers): a drowned priest of the fog in a deep sea-blue robe to the ground, a pale barnacle rune band round the hem (the signature), a barnacle-crusted shoulder mantle, a deep hood over a grey face with sea-foam glow eyes, wide bell sleeves, kelp trailing from the hood, cuffs, belt and hem, a rope cord with a conch charm, a driftwood rod with a conch in the right hand, a team sash with a barry-wavy tail. Tier I only. No back flag.
